name: popkey
description: PopKey is an animated GIF keyboard. Use the API to access PopKey's extensive collection of GIFs. The RESTful API uses HTTP methods over SSL with responses in JSON. An API Key is required for authentication. Use the API to search for GIFs by category or popularity and generate lists of similar types of content. PopKey can also generate content randomly. See the API docs for detailed instructions on getting started with PopKey.

name: pulseway-rest
description: Pulseway provides a RESTful API that monitors up to 5 IT systems for free and more with a subscribed account. With this application used in any mobile device, developers can manage systems, control applications and display data. They can also use Web Hooks to interact with the instances in real time. This API aims to offer the benefit of notification when parameters are out of bounds and when errors occur. Developers in the IT field could benefit from Pulseway RESTful API that is about IT systems monitoring. In the site, developers can find the feature of basic authentication in Ruby, Python, Node.js, Perl, PHP, C#, Java, cURL and JSON formats. In the same page, users can find tools to identify errors, publish, and receive notifications. Besides a RESTful API, Pulseway offers a Cloud API in Java and .NET languages along with tutorials to facilitate application development.

name: enigma
description: Enigma Public is a community platform that brings together thousands of public data sources for discovery. Enigma Public encourages users to find connections with data for new insights and analysis.The Enigma API allows developers to access and integrate the functionality of Enigma with other applications and to create new applications. API methods are available to create, retrieve, and manage collections, datasets, tags, accounts, and more.

name: gta-xml
description: GTA-Travel is a global travel product provider that has sourced a broad portfolio of accommodation options, transfer services, city tours, tour guides, excursions, restaurants, and over 45,000 vendors in 185 countries. The GTA XML API allows travel vendors to access the GTA database of travel content for reservation systems or third-party websites and applications. The services uses REST calls and returns XML. An account is required with service.

name: cloudboost
description: The CloudBoost API provides database services for building apps. The REST API uses JSON over HTTP with HTTP Basic Auth for authentication. Use CloudBoost to add data-storage, search, graphs, and realtime to your apps. See the extensive API documentation for detailed instructions on setting up your database.

name: admitad
description: The Admitad API, available in English and Russian languages, allows implementation of affiliated marketing features. It can be useful to analyze statistics and publish in the Admitad app store. Protocols in JSON available with an Api Key. Amitad is an affiliate marketing platform with 700 advertisers and 250K + publishers.

name: expertrec-requesting-recommendations-data
description: The ExpertRec Requesting Recommendations Data API allows developers to get various types of recommendations including Viewed Also Viewed, Viewed Ended Buying, Recommended Items, Similar, Trending, and Top Selling. Developers can request multiple recommendation types in a single API call. ExpertRec is a site search and product recommendation service that uses advanced AI and machine learning algorithms.

name: google-knowledge-graph-search
description: The Google Knowledge Graph Search API is a tool that helps users find entities within the Google Knowledge Graph. Some of the features provided by the Google Knowledge Graph Search API are: get a ranked list of the most notable entities that match certain criteria; ability to predictably complete entities in a search box; and annotate and organize content using the Knowledge Graph entities. The Google Knowledge Graph is an innovative knowledge base used to enhance Google's search results with semantic-search information gathered from a variety of sources.
